metadata.numeric_representation: Unbounded mathematical Lean Rat (exact rational arithmetic). All signed inputs; independent numerator/denominator sizes; no overflow, floating point, fixed scale, rounding or denominator bound.
metadata.semantic_level: Adapted native DeFiFormal financial library at abstract-model level. Native Core.execute and Examples.move/pulse financial operations are generalized to symbolic users, vaults and independent rates. Canonical raw validation, reusable capability-set administration, sequence, rollback, net settlement and receipts are newly authored wrappers; not measurements of native Typed.Authority or Atomic.runAtomic.
metadata.proof_method: Lean elaboration, tactic replay and kernel checking. Unchanged pre-target aesop automatic stage; AI-authored local contracts, explicit native theorem applications, induction, finite-case algebra and arithmetic tactics are assisted. Each replay recompiles the complete new dependency chain. Separate leanchecker jobs replay every new module without source tactics, using the same Lean kernel and trusted pinned imported dependencies; not --fresh.
assumptions: Canonical valid public state: all native balances nonnegative, independent positive rational vault rates, unused native debt cells zero; supply is derived from the exact balance sums.
Full unbounded rational amounts and all canonical principals, users, vaults and asset aliases; malformed raw encodings and excluded inputs have explicit prioritized refusals.
Administrator is the fixed canonical role; capability sets are finite over the complete canonical capability universe. Native State proof fields are not public observables.
abstractions: Abstract financial and control semantics only, without deployed-code, network or economic-solvency equivalence.
This evaluation covers seven measured cases R3-N4, R3-N16 and R4 through R8. Separate R1/R2 evaluations remain separate; coverage and timings are not pooled.
R8 is a second vault instance of the frozen generic composition contract; it is not evidence of arbitrary protocol extension.

Sequential execution checks gross funds/authority; net settlement checks aggregate debits and emits one aggregate event; atomic publication restores the entire entry state on refusal. These controls are assessment-added.

Pinned mathlib and transitive precompiled dependencies from checksummed offline archive
Python adapter/input envelope and host OS

metadata.source_counting_method: Executed Lean --deps import inventory plus declaration-role review and a comment-aware Lean physical-line scanner. Operational definitions, canonical specifications, direct AI guidance and shared AI helper modules are distinct. Shared physical source counted once with complete case use lists. Acceptance probes, infrastructure, immutable checkpoint copies and native snapshots are separate inventory classes.

new_definitions: WorkflowModel canonical financial wrappers, authority, public state and receipts
ComposeModel algebraic full success domain and workflow specification
new_proof_obligations: Local native execution success, computation, accounting and frame
Deposit and withdrawal surplus for every user/vault
Composition initialization, local contract preservation and first-refusal equivalence
RationalReuse.canonical: same generic composition theorem instantiated at true,4

R3-COMPOSE-N4.sequence_strategy: Generic list induction using checked local execution contracts and algebraic full success domain; instantiate N=4.

R3-COMPOSE-N16.sequence_strategy: Same generic list induction and checked local contracts; instantiate N=16 with independent input amounts.

R4-REFUSAL.sequence_strategy: Total raw-call executor: first refusal, exact committed prefix and disabled suffix for arbitrary four-call lists.

R5-REVOKE.sequence_strategy: Symbolic two-call revoke/use with exact authority precedence, plus all administrator-only grant/revoke transitions.

R6-ATOMIC.sequence_strategy: Stage the same raw sequence; publish all successful events or restore every public entry-state component on first refusal.

R7-NET.sequence_strategy: Aggregate four transfer effects; prove signed-delta accounting and exact net authority/funds, with separate sequential gross-prefix iff.

R8-REUSE.sequence_strategy: Instantiate the frozen generic composition theorem at vault B and N=4 with independent positive B rate.

setup_notes: Unchanged aesop/maxHeartbeats=20000 procedure and actual unrelated-example evidence selected before the earlier rational targets are reused without retuning. All AI-selected helpers/tactics remain assisted.
Every scored replay/check job covers its complete declared dependency chain; build compiles each new assisted module once in topological order. R8 includes its actual R3-N4 foundation dependency.
Offline reconstruction repeats all acceptance checks from fresh source/home/cache; shared host and trusted imported binary dependencies are explicit.
Compiled module sizes include model/specification/proof declarations, not isolated theorem certificates.
The ordinary case effort ledger includes shared infrastructure and acceptance work. The reuse phase ledger overlaps that case effort and measures the incremental B proof extension separately.
